what: Held-out silhouette IoU per object per method. 'iou' = computed here for every method on the same held-out frames (every 8th, eval_final frame list, mask label errors excluded), union-of-triangles silhouette vs SAM2 mask, other instances don't-care, no inter-object occlusion. 'reported' = numbers from earlier pipeline reports, cited by file.
